name: creai-axis-telemetry
description: Opt-in usage telemetry for creai-axis. Installs a session hook that, once a developer opts in, sends one metadata-only event per creai-axis skill used to the team's adoption dashboard.

plugins.name: creai-telemetry
plugins.description: creai-axis usage collector (inert until opt-in) and the /creai-telemetry:creai-usage skill to opt in, backfill, check status or opt out.
